verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own site describes a Notion-like editor with many formatting options and custom components for help-center docs, and help articles have body-editing support. That covers the core of the story for help content, but the evidence never explicitly says the same editor is used for changelog posts. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the rich editor and custom components apply to changelog authoring, detailed docs on which custom components are available, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
